treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Armenia and the Kingdom of the Netherlands for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital, and Protocol (2001, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: [NL list] Armenië DTA In werking 31-10-2001 22-11-2002 || [AM MLI position] ...Capital Kingdom of Netherlands Original 31-10-2001 22-11-2002
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the AM-NL Convention and Protocol (MLISynthesizedTextNetherlands.docx, Armenian MoF)

rates.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of subparagraph (a) of paragraph 2 of Article 10 (Dividends), the rate of withholding tax provided in that subparagraph shall be lowered to 0% in case the profits out of which the dividends are paid have been effectively taxed at the normal rate for profits tax and the dividends are exempt from tax in the hands of the company receiving such dividends. [MLI Art. 8(1):] Subparagraph a) of paragraph 2 of Article 10 of the Convention shall apply only if the ownership conditions described in those provisions are met throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividends

5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends; [MLI Art. 8(1):] Subparagraph a) of paragraph 2 of Article 10 of the Convention shall apply only if the ownership conditions described in those provisions are met throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividends
15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit

notes: Dividends: Protocol lowers the 10(2)(a) rate to 0% where the underlying profits were effectively taxed at the normal profits-tax rate and the dividends are exempt for the receiving company. Protocol (second 'Ad Article 10'): anti-abuse rule allowing the source State to levy up to 15% combined where redistribution to individuals in the other State would be lightly taxed, unless the recipient is government-owned, listed, or engaged in active business (or competent authorities agree) - not modelled. 365-day holding for 10(2)(a) tiers added by MLI Art. 8(1), effective for WHT from 2024-01-01 (no holding period before). Interest Art. 11(3): taxable only in residence State if recipient is a State/subdivision/local authority/statutory body/Central Bank, if paid by a State, on State-guaranteed/insured loans, on sale-on-credit of equipment/merchandise/services between enterprises, or on any loan granted by a bank. Art. 32: provisions effective for taxable years and periods beginning on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2002-11-22 -> 2003-01-01). Synthesised text: MLI effective for WHT from 1 January 2024.
